summary: Flathead NF ground cabin with an L-4 cab dated 1930 and abandoned in 1943 per firelookout.com; the FFLA Montana list says it is gone.

facts.design: Ground cabin with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Listed as Gone by the FFLA Montana list; firelookout.com says it was abandoned in 1943. Neither describes what, if anything, remains.

events.note: firelookout.com dates the L-4 cab to 1930. It does not say the cabin was built that year.

evidence.supports: page calls the site a cabin
Lake and Flathead County at 7,629 feet
FFLA lists the site as a ground structure and gone
evidence.quote: Inspiration Point Flathead/ Lake 47.77647 -113.65273 Ground Gone

evidence.supports: L-4 cab is a 14-by-14-foot frame cab a lookout could live in, which could sit atop a tall tower
evidence.quote: 14'x14' frame cabs were made to live in and could be placed atop tall firetowers.

notes_for_editor: Thin. One lookout page (firelookout.com) gives the dates, design and elevation, and the FFLA Montana list confirms Ground and Gone. Searches found no newspaper, Forest Service or register record for the lookout. The page's line 'Patrol point 1.5 miles NE at 7745'. Gone.' appears to mark the patrol point as gone, not the lookout, so it is not used as status evidence; the story leaves the patrol point out because the page does not say what it was. Elevation is not a schema key, so it is only in the story. No photo added; the page's image link was not checked. Record coordinates match the FFLA list and the firelookout.com map.
